## Queue: implement the CRITICAL remediation item #44 with #20–29

**Parent:** [44-item index #71](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/71). **Status: UNBLOCKED / READY FOR CODEX HANDOFF — NOT YET EXECUTED.** The owner merged [PR #75](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/75) and exact post-merge CI [38974225858](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/actions/runs/38974225858) passed on main `f371448538dafa92faebbef9bcda2a36c6ca1fa9`. Read the [2026-10-16 owner-continuation/Codex task handoff](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/73#issuecomment-6226100456) before creating any scoped task or branch. Issue #72's implementation dependency is cleared; no Codex runtime has been started from this coordinator chat and no owner-only admin/merge/hosted action is authorized.

### Problem

Vellistry previously allowed the ChatGPT coordinator to perform implementation directly through GitHub despite Codex being assigned as primary coder. PR70 demonstrates that Task/ContextPack/ExecutionBundle packaging can work, but it is **not** proof that unauthorized implementation is technically prevented. Existing source/docs and PR authorship must remain distinguishable from claimed execution-agent identity.

### Codex-only bounded goal (after owner dispatch)

Implement enforceable **PR-to-task compliance evidence** for qualifying application/CI/security-code changes, with clear low-risk documentation/research exemptions and owner-authorized exception records. No new MCP/orchestrator/knowledge server (#43).

1. Produce a tiny auditable policy: qualifying changed paths; unique task ID, owner authorization link, permitted scope, non-overridable prohibited actions, pinned pack commit/blob hashes, real Git executor/model claims, ExecutionBundle linked to exact code, independent review checklist and owner disposition. Security-sensitive migrations must also preserve explicit migration approval.
2. Add CI validation to the **existing consolidated** `Vellistry CI`, not a parallel automatic workflow. Fail closed for required missing/invalid task, pack, bundle, unauthorized path/scope, expired/superseded owner authorization, forged completion, and unjustified role-substitution. Treat honest `NOT_STARTED`, `NOT_RUN` and `BLOCKED` as non-passing when a required implementation evidence check needs actual execution.
3. **Trust limitation:** GitHub commit author/runner/PR user and self-declared model string cannot cryptographically prove which LLM executed edits. Require verifiable provenance/evidence plus owner and reviewer checks; never claim complete technical prevention where only detection/attestation exists.
4. Add unit-negative tests for: no Task, no pack, mutated immutable pack, missing head evidence, ChatGPT-claimed Codex execution, review without owner acceptance, reusing a Phase-A-only task after Phase-B extension, deleted compliance test, documented low-risk docs-only exception, ready-vs-draft, and handling externally authored/reused commits with preserved origins.
5. Preserve red draft advisory gate, full ready/main security tests, all manual historical workflows and existing author-isolation negative cases. Do not accidentally make initial PRs impossible to adopt due to a circular task bootstrap requirement.
6. Add narrowly defined, owner-verifiable exception/reassignment procedure; exception never silently extends permissions to Supabase migrations, production/private manuscripts, paid services or merges.
7. Demonstrate on a disposable/synthetic test PR or local Git fixture; don't create a real malicious PR, use secrets or merge. Provide a Task → immutable ContextPack → ExecutionBundle and draft PR with exact-head evidence for ChatGPT independent review, then owner decision.

### Approval boundaries

No product feature coding, hosted DB operations, cloud migration, production changes, real manuscripts, paid services, changes to branch protection, merge or owner-only decisions are authorized. If GitHub plan does not support required checks, **report** the exact limitation and an owner-controlled manual fallback. Never silently change repository administrator settings.

**Task IDs:** allocate unique numbers from latest actual task inventory **after #72**, not a guessed ID. The original approved checklist #44 wording and linked issues (#20, #21, #23, #28, #29) govern the objective.

**Acceptance:** a qualifying implementation PR lacking valid governed evidence cannot receive a merge-eligible green CI gate; docs-only reasonable exemptions are tested; agent provenance is reported with real trust limitations; reviewer/owner approval remains separate.

## Owner continuation → bounded Codex handoff for VEL-GOV-003 (2026-10-16)

**AUTHORIZATION CONTEXT (coordinator relay, not a GitHub-authored owner comment):** After the owner chose to continue Vellistry's 44-item remediation, with #73 identified as the next priority following the merged governance PR, the owner replied **"lets continue fixing"** in the coordinating ChatGPT conversation. Interpret this as authorization to **start the already-scoped #73 repository-only compliance task through Codex**, **not** blanket approval for further waves, billable services, migrations, cloud actions, merges or owner-only governance decisions.

**DEPENDENCY CLEARED:** Owner merged [PR #75](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/75) at `f371448538dafa92faebbef9bcda2a36c6ca1fa9` on 2026-10-16; real ready PR CI [38973835858](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/actions/runs/38973835858) and merged-main full CI [38974225858](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/actions/runs/38974225858) succeeded on their exact heads. Current `main` was rechecked at `f371448538dafa92faebbef9bcda2a36c6ca1fa9`. The effective `AGENTS.md` and ADR-0008 select Codex as primary implementer. Existing unmerged PR #66 is historically superseded by the sourced PR75 adoption but remains owner-disposition-only; do not alter it here.

**Assigned roles:** ChatGPT plans/coordinates and independently reviews; **Codex alone implements**; project owner approves consequential scope, final PR acceptance/merge and account/branch protections. This comment is a task handoff, **not** a Codex runtime invocation.

### Codex instructions — VEL-GOV-003 (P0 role/provenance enforcement)

1. **First, inventory live source** at current actual `main`: `AGENTS.md`, ADR-0008, `PROJECT-CONSTITUTION.md`, `SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md`, `docs/agent-workflow/README.md`, task/pack/bundle schemas and validator; `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `scripts/ci_policy.py`, `scripts/ci_governance.py`, existing regression tests and all active PR/task refs. Do not assume an old checkpoint remains current.
2. **Formal bounded handoff before coding:** isolated Codex worktree/branch from observed `main`; allocate an actually unused Task/CP/EB ID (e.g. 0010 only after collision check across all refs); capture this issue and any owner authorization source as a labeled snapshot, the intended path allowlist and negative cases. Commit task/sources → generate/validate/commit **immutable** pinned ContextPack → begin implementation. Owner's conversation dispatch is coordinator-relayed, not independently authenticated by an issue-comment author; disclose that provenance.
3. **First produce a coverage/trust design:** classify qualifying implementation changes (app, SQL, auth, tests, CI, agent/approval instructions and executable tools) separately from proportionate docs-only triage; map existing Task/CP/EB and proof points to required CI checks; document legacy/bootstrapping handling and exact owner approval points. Keep `main` reference/evaluation trust explicit.
4. **Implement in the ONE existing automatic `Vellistry CI`:** add an efficient guarded PR-compliance validator integrated into governance/final gate; **do not create a new automatic workflow** or duplicate builds. Detect absent/mismatched task/pack/blob pins, material task-scope expansion without amendment, missing or contradictory declared executor, missing/inaccurate ExecutionBundle, undeclared inherited authored/cherry-picked commits, and forbidden changed paths. Treat unexecuted proofs `NOT_RUN/BLOCKED` truthfully. Preserve approved docs-only exemptions and draft advisory blocked gate.
5. **Trust boundary must remain honest:** a PR can edit its own tests/workflow; attacker-controlled PR code/metadata/commit names cannot prove owner identity, Codex runtime identity or human approval. Avoid claiming that YAML rules and GitHub checks alone prevent a malicious contributor bypass without owner-protected branch rules and a trusted validator. Make authorization verification human-verifiable, fail closed when applicable, and document exactly what CI can attest. No `pull_request_target` checkout/execution of untrusted PR code; no token/secrets or privilege elevation. Prefer an auditable base-anchored/static verification approach consistent with current read-only `pull_request` workflow, but STOP/flag owner if actual GitHub enforcement requires changing branch-protection settings.
6. **Negative/positive test matrix:** missing Task; unavailable pack; mutated pack or source blob; wrong task/base; Phase-A task reused for later Phase B; disallowed SQL/CI/app path; fake executor claim and mixed-source commits; missing EB/head evidence; owner approval spoofing; task scope exceptions; governance-only exemption; draft/ready/full/main modes; files added/renamed/deleted; self-editing CI/validator (including no-check discovery); absent/malformed metadata; green security checks cannot hide missing required PR evidence; no circular blocker when introducing the compliance system itself. Distinguish *local synthetic* tests from actual live PR event tests and from independently established owner identity.
7. **Sustain cost savings:** retain single CI entrypoint, cheap ordinary draft validation, cancel obsolete PR runs, and one full ready/main path. No change to the already verified author-isolation, PostgreSQL, token, security or recovery suites. If a compliance fix would require substantial redesign or privileged API scopes, isolate it as a decision-required blocker rather than silently adding orchestration.
8. **Deliver:** small staged commits; actual commands/exit codes; policy, test, changed-path, authorization and attack-surface matrices; new valid Task/CP/EB; a **draft PR** at exact SHA with run/evidence links and explicit caveats. Return to ChatGPT for source/negative CI review and to owner for final acceptance. **Do not merge.**

### Scope exclusions and owner checkpoints

No hosted Supabase reads/writes, migrations, user fixtures, real manuscripts, service-role tokens, deployments, payments, edits to PR #68/#66/#65, branch-protection changes, account management, release or merge. The separately queued PG17 evidence task [#74](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/74) remains distinct and its proposed third privilege migration remains unapproved.

**Status after this comment:** owner continuation **relayed to Codex task queue**; actual Codex execution **NOT_STARTED through this ChatGPT connection**, no Task/CP/EB0010 or source change created yet. Once Codex has executed, it must supply verifiable exact-head artifacts; coordinator will not substitute itself as implementer.
